message.content:
According to the source [Just the Two of Us (Grover Washington Jr. song)], the edited version of "Just the Two of Us" reached number two on the Billboard Hot 100 behind "Bette Davis Eyes" by Kim Carnes. 
The source [Bette Davis Eyes] states that "Bette Davis Eyes" was written and composed by Donna Weiss and Jackie DeShannon, and Kim Carnes's 1981 version spent nine weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

Final answer: nine weeks
